correctness.rationale: For strict ternary length-two circular profiles, flow balance reduces the off-diagonal entries to three equal signed gaps. Quotienting only objective-preserving labels leaves 420 shape classes. For fixed positive gap \(t\), substitution \(H_i=L_i+t\) turns all adjacent rank inequalities into exact lower-bound difference constraints. The verifier computes their componentwise least nonnegative solution by longest-path closure for every shape and every \(1\le t\le28\); all shapes have optimum at most \(86\), while \(t\ge29\) alone contributes at least \(87\). The unique worst shape has an independent direct lower bound \(86\), and the balanced matrix \(\begin{pmatrix}12&5&6\\0&13&15\\11&10&14\end{pmatrix}\) attains it and is replayed as an Eulerian circuit.
